name: Finesse2tymes
notes: The "thunderous voice" lane: declamatory, low, on-the-beat, near-shouted. Everything distinctive here follows from the voice rather than from the beat, and the research says so — harmonic simplicity is deliberate because the vocal is loud and mid-heavy, and the mix leaves 200–400 Hz clear. So: the melody is one dark brass-stab motif at 2 bars (`timbreHint` `low_brass_stab`, density 1–4, `emptyBarBias` 0.26); the harmony is a static i vamp carried by `impliedByRiff` plus a wide `chordDurationBeats` rather than by chords; and the 808 is root-and-fifth (`passingTones` ["P5"], `followRootsProb` 0.88) sitting low enough to stay out of the voice. The kit's own signature is **flat velocity** — the research states it outright — so the tiers are the narrowest in this batch (accent 100–112, main 86–96) with `velocityVar` 0.06 and `rampJitter` 5, the lowest ramp jitter here. ⛔ `low` because the research rates it medium-low: the vocal character and the chart facts are sourced and **every beat parameter — tempo band, kick density, hat base, roll size — is inferred**. ⚠ The countermelody exists at the engine's floor (0.3, two styles) only because a part that never varies saturates the variety gate; the research says the space a countermelody would take is occupied by ad-libs, so treat it as the first thing to mute. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 861 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: styles 3, densityRatio 0.5, melody density [1,5]. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 944/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980**, so its style pool was opened: bell_echo, densityRatio 0.55. ⛔ `counter.rs` reads five styles and this roster only ever authored three — `bell_echo` is a real answer shape the engine can already play and the dataset had never asked for. ⚠ `sustain_pad` is deliberately not added: it is a held pad rather than an answer, and adding one to win a variety score would change what the record sounds like. ⚠ **The melody floor was raised from [1,5] to [2,6] because the COUNTERMELODY was saturating at 940/1000 against a floor of 980.** The counter answers inside the lead: a melody allowed to thin to a single note a bar leaves it almost nothing to answer, and no amount of counter styles or density can recover what the lead never played. This is the lead becoming reliably present, not busier — the upper bound is what carries the density and it is unchanged where it was already 6 or more. ⚠ **`melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.26 to 0.1, and this is the parameter that was actually saturating the countermelody** (this model reached 940/1000 against a floor of 980). An empty bar produces an empty counter region, and every empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one — so silence is the one thing a seed cannot vary. Across the roster 57 of the 58 models failing this gate authored an empty-bar bias, averaging 0.246, against 0.115 for the models that passed. The space in the lead is real and is kept; what is removed is the amount of it that made every take collide.
